purpose: Reconcile stale pre-v9 text snapshots with independently reviewed source already present at checkpoint b684330. This is not acceptance of v9 designs.
scope: Only the recorded old/new context and style tuples were replaced. No record mode, route-wide exemption, source CSS change, or blanket snapshot acceptance was used. Future unknown/changed contexts still fail.

dispositions.scope: Identical reviewed shared footer/navigation old/new tuples on other routes

dispositions.scope: Eight 404 eyebrow, four About badge, two hundred editorial eyebrow and twenty-eight career note tuples
dispositions.reason: Preexisting typography/contrast overrides already in the checkpoint; source and representative screenshots independently reviewed.

validation.contractMutationTests: Unchanged accepted; new label, wrong size, lost emphasis, color, italic, missing route, failed capture and empty state rejected.

reviewEvidence: Local artifacts/v9-bootstrap/independent-review contains desktop/mobile hero, body, footer and additional-context screenshots and source dispositions; inventory-diff.json records the complete reviewed changes.
limitations: This records typography provenance, not a blanket accessibility approval.
